title: Auto Loans: courtesy late charge waiver allowance by product
content:
# Auto Loans: courtesy late charge waiver allowance by product

This quick reference gives two settings of each Auto Loans product at PCB that concern courtesy waivers of late charges: how many courtesy late charge waivers one customer may receive in a rolling 365 days, and how many consecutive on-time installments before the late one a courtesy waiver requires.

| Auto Loans product | Courtesy waivers per customer in a rolling 365 days | Consecutive on-time installments required before the late one |
|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 1 | 6 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 1 | 6 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 1 | 6 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 1 | 6 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 1 | 6 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 2 | 6 |

Both settings are whole counts.

## Points of judgement

**Is the allowance the same on every product?** The on-time requirement is 6 installments everywhere. The number of courtesy waivers differs: 2 on the Green Vehicle Loan, 1 on every other product.

**Lookup illustration (hypothetical):** a borrower asking about a late charge on a Green Vehicle Loan reads an allowance of 2 courtesy waivers in the rolling 365 days and a requirement of 6 consecutive on-time installments; the same question on a New Vehicle Loan reads 1 and 6.
